# Paint It Easy

> A Swiss creative art studio offering painting, drawing, and ceramics courses with paint-and-sip events across Basel and Zurich.

Paint It Easy (PIE) is a Swiss-based creative community providing beginner-friendly art classes, workshops, and social painting events. The platform features flexible membership options, regular studio classes, multi-day courses, and paint-and-sip experiences across their Basel and Zurich locations.

## Key Topics

- Paint It Easy (PIE)
- Basel & Zürich locations
- Painting courses
- Drawing courses
- Acrylic pouring
- Ceramics & pottery
- Creative cafés
- PIE Events (paint-and-sip)
- Studio Class (membership)
- Beginner-friendly
- Workshop calendar
- Multi-day courses
- Action painting
- Urban sketching
- Calligraphy

## Painting & Drawing Courses

- [Kreativ Workshops in Basel & Zürich: Malen, Kreativität & mehr | Paint It Easy](https://paintiteasy.ch/workshops): Main workshops page covering painting, ceramics & creative courses
- [Malkurse mit Fun-Garantie | Paint It Easy | Paint It Easy](https://paintiteasy.ch/malkurse): Painting courses for all levels including acrylic pouring
- [Zeichenkurse – deine Kreativität | Paint It Easy | Paint It Easy](https://paintiteasy.ch/zeichenkurse): Drawing courses for beginners and professionals in Basel & Zurich
- [Paint It Easy – Kreative Acyl Malkurse mit Spassfaktor | Paint It Easy](https://paintiteasy.ch/acryl-malkurse): Acrylic painting courses with pouring techniques for all levels
- [Paint It Easy – Aquarell Malkurse mit viel Spass | Paint It Easy](https://paintiteasy.ch/aqurarell-malkurse): Watercolor painting courses for beginners and professionals
- [Malen für Erwachsene in Zürich & Basel | Paint It Easy](https://paintiteasy.ch/malen-fuer-erwachsene): Adult painting and drawing courses in Basel and Zurich

## Specialized Art Techniques

- [Kalligraphie Kurse: Kunstvoll schön schreiben | Paint It Easy](https://paintiteasy.ch/kalligraphie-kurs): Calligraphy courses teaching artistic handwriting techniques
- [Aktzeichnen Kurse: Die Kunst des menschlichen Körpers | Paint It Easy](https://paintiteasy.ch/aktzeichnen-kurs): Figure drawing courses focusing on human body sketching
- [Action Painting – lass die Farben fliegen | Paint It Easy](https://paintiteasy.ch/action-painting): Action painting workshops with dripping and color experiments
- [Urban Sketching Kurse – kreative und individuelle Auszeit | Paint It Easy](https://paintiteasy.ch/urban-sketching): Urban sketching courses teaching outdoor drawing techniques
- [Graffitikurs bei PIE – Dein neuer Style-Move | Paint It Easy](https://paintiteasy.ch/graffitikurs): Graffiti drawing courses for beginners and advanced artists
- [Freies Malen: Kreative Auszeit ohne Regeln | Paint It Easy](https://paintiteasy.ch/freies-malen): Free painting sessions with no rules for creative expression

## Membership & Regular Classes

- [Studio Class: Regelmässige Malstunden in der Schweiz bei PIE | Paint It Easy](https://paintiteasy.ch/studio-class): Regular weekly painting classes with flexible membership passes
- [Mehrtägige Kreativkurse in Basel & Zürich | Paint It Easy](https://paintiteasy.ch/mehrtaegige-kurse): Multi-day creative and painting courses in Basel and Zurich

## Ceramics & Studio Access

- [Offenes Atelier für Keramik in Zürich | Paint It Easy](https://paintiteasy.ch/offenes-atelier): Open ceramic studio in Zurich with professional equipment
